item.name: Six Eyes
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and press G on PC to open the Six Eyes sequence.
item.moveSummary: Replaces Honored One's base tools with powered-up Blue and Red variants, Hollow Purple, Limitless, and Infinite Void pressure.
item.followUpOrDomain: Infinite Void and the alternate 0.2 Domain
item.cardSummary: Honored One's meter activation opens the Six Eyes kit and its upgraded Limitless tools.

item.name: King of Curses
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and press G on PC to let the Vessel sequence switch into Sukuna's kit.
item.moveSummary: Replaces Vessel's kit with Dismantle, Open, Rush, Cleave, World Cutting Slash, and Malevolent Shrine pressure.
item.followUpOrDomain: Malevolent Shrine
item.cardSummary: The Vessel awakening hands control to Sukuna and replaces the base kit with his cursed techniques.

item.name: Idle Death Gamble
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Restless Gambler's awakening to open the pachinko domain.
item.moveSummary: Opens the pachinko domain and supplies the lucky attacks, Energy Surge, and Rhythm route around its Jackpot roll.
item.followUpOrDomain: Idle Death Gamble and its Jackpot outcome
item.cardSummary: Restless Gambler's awakening opens Idle Death Gamble and starts the roll toward Jackpot.

item.name: Insanity
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Ten Shadows' awakening; the later Mahoraga route uses the separate Ritual path.
item.moveSummary: Unlocks Max Elephant, Great Serpent, Shadow Swarm, Lurking Shadow, and Switch before the Mahoraga route becomes available.
item.followUpOrDomain: Mahoraga path through Ritual and the Chimera Shadow Garden interaction
item.cardSummary: Ten Shadows enters Insanity first, with a separate Mahoraga ritual path available afterward.

item.name: Essence of the Soul
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Perfection's awakening; landing Awakening Black Flash twice can open the super state.
item.moveSummary: Adds Idle Transfiguration, Body Disfigure, Spike Wrath, Embodiment of Self Perfection, and Awakening Black Flash to Perfection's kit.
item.followUpOrDomain: Embodiment of Self Perfection and Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing
item.cardSummary: Essence of the Soul is Perfection's full awakening, with Awakening Black Flash leading toward its super state.

item.name: Duty as a Brother
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Blood Manipulator's awakening to open the blood technique sequence.
item.moveSummary: Opens the blood-based kit with Slicing Exorcism, Wing King, Blood Rain, Plasma Wave, and Convergence.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed
item.cardSummary: Blood Manipulator's awakening opens the Duty as a Brother blood technique kit.

item.name: False Memories
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Switcher's awakening to start the brother-and-idol sequence.
item.moveSummary: Brings the brother-and-idol sequence into play through Idol's Debut, Climax Jumping, Dreams, Brothers, and Boogie Woogie.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed
item.cardSummary: False Memories activates Switcher's brother-and-idol awakening sequence.

item.name: Deadly Sentencing
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Defense Attorney's awakening to expand the trial domain.
item.moveSummary: Turns the awakening into a courtroom trial with Execution, Final Judgement, Verdict, Triple Sentence, and Domain Amplification.
item.followUpOrDomain: Deadly Sentencing trial and Death Penalty after a qualifying verdict
item.cardSummary: Deadly Sentencing turns Defense Attorney's awakening into an invulnerable courtroom trial.

item.name: True Love
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate the sequence by tearing the necklace and putting on its ring.
item.moveSummary: Fully manifests Rika and adds Elbow Rush, Copy, Energy Ripple, and the Authentic Mutual Love route.
item.followUpOrDomain: Authentic Mutual Love and Copy Wheel
item.cardSummary: True Love fully manifests Rika and unlocks Cursed Partners' copied-technique route.

item.name: Absolute
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Puppet Master's awakening to switch into the mech form.
item.moveSummary: Replaces the puppet with a giant mech and its Miracle Cannon, Pigeon Viola, Absolute Destruction, Technique Charge, and Energy Output tools.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed
item.cardSummary: Absolute turns Puppet Master into a giant mech with a separate powered attack kit.

item.name: Vengeance
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Head of the Hei's awakening through the slowed Bleedout sequence.
item.moveSummary: Transforms the user for Top Speed, Flash Freezing, Tendril Grab, Time Cell Moon Palace, and Acceleration pressure.
item.followUpOrDomain: Time Cell Moon Palace
item.cardSummary: Vengeance starts Head of the Hei's reincarnated awakening form and its speed-focused kit.

item.name: Overtime
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate Salaryman's awakening to enter the cleaver-based overtime form.
item.moveSummary: Adds Ratio Breaker, Sharpen, Interrogate, Collapse, and Ratio Point while Salaryman fights in the overtime form.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed
item.cardSummary: Overtime gives Salaryman a cleaver-based awakening built around Ratio pressure.

item.name: Every Last Drop.
item.activationOrRequirement: Fill the Awakening meter and activate True Cannon's awakening to commit its cursed energy to the cannon route.
item.moveSummary: Charges the cannon's strongest blast and supplies What are you after?, I had no idea..., This is what dessert is like!, You weren't invited., and Restyle.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed
item.cardSummary: Every Last Drop. commits True Cannon's energy to its strongest awakened blast.

item.name: Ritual
item.activationOrRequirement: Use Ten Shadows' Mahoraga path and perform the Ritual against an enemy within 60 studs.
item.moveSummary: Provides the Mahoraga route, including the ritual summon and the adaptation states that follow it.
item.followUpOrDomain: Mahoraga and its adaptation or alternate modes
item.cardSummary: Ritual is Ten Shadows' secondary Mahoraga route rather than a duplicate character entry.

item.name: Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing
item.awakeningName: Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing
item.activationOrRequirement: During Essence of the Soul, land Awakening Black Flash twice to fill the rainbow bar and unlock the super awakening.
item.moveSummary: Swaps Perfection into the super state with Widespread Strikes, Face Blitz, Crushing Rushdown, and Head Splitter.
item.followUpOrDomain: Perfection's secondary state with no separate domain listed
item.cardSummary: Perfection's super awakening is reached by landing Awakening Black Flash twice and filling the rainbow bar.

item.name: Directed Poison
item.activationOrRequirement: Use Locust Guy's awakening input; this character has a named special instead of a full awakened kit.
item.moveSummary: Uses the insect abdomen for a sting that applies poison, with no full awakened moveset listed.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed because this is a base-only replacement
item.cardSummary: Directed Poison is Locust Guy's base-only awakening replacement rather than a complete new kit.

item.name: Unrestricted Density
item.activationOrRequirement: Use Star Rage's awakening input; this character has a named special instead of a full awakened kit.
item.moveSummary: Pushes the Mass technique past its normal limit so Star Rage can hurl their body onto a target, with no full awakened moveset listed.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed because this is a base-only replacement
item.cardSummary: Unrestricted Density is Star Rage's base-only awakening special and its Mass-limit payoff.

item.name: Foresight
item.activationOrRequirement: Use the Foresight counter when a melee attack comes in; its execution can trigger against an attacker at 40 HP or less.
item.moveSummary: Guards against a melee hit and knocks the attacker away, with a low-health execution variant instead of a full awakened moveset.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed because this is a base-only replacement
item.cardSummary: Foresight is Aspiring Mangaka's base-only awakening counter, including a low-health execution route.

item.name: Jawbreaker
item.activationOrRequirement: Use the awakening special while unarmed; Jawbreaker can still be used during stun.
item.moveSummary: Slides the Hand Sword back and throws it at the target as a single awakening special, with no full awakened moveset listed.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed because this is a base-only replacement
item.cardSummary: Jawbreaker is Lucky Coward's unarmed base-only awakening special and can work during stun.

item.name: Bird Strike
item.activationOrRequirement: Use the awakening special, guide the crow toward a target, and land a direct impact for the detonation.
item.moveSummary: Lets Crow Charmer control a crow and detonate it on a direct target impact instead of switching to a full awakened moveset.
item.followUpOrDomain: No full domain listed because this is a base-only replacement
item.cardSummary: Bird Strike is Crow Charmer's base-only awakening special: guide the crow, then land its impact.

item.name: Parthenogenesis
item.activationOrRequirement: Use the awakening ability to spend Black Death's cursed energy and split the character in two.
item.moveSummary: Uses all cursed energy to create the split with invulnerability during the transition, with no full awakened moveset listed.
item.followUpOrDomain: Infestation interaction and no full domain listed
item.cardSummary: Parthenogenesis is Black Death's base-only awakening ability and spends cursed energy on the split.
